title: Pullback of an associated module sheaf
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ and $(Y,\mathcal O_Y)$ be ringed spaces, put $R=\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ and $S=\Gamma(Y,\mathcal O_Y)$, let $M$ be an $R$-module, and let $\mathcal F_M$ be the quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module associated to $M$ by the standard ringed-space construction. For a morphism of ringed spaces $g:Y\to X$, the pullback $g^*\mathcal F_M$ is canonically and functorially isomorphic to the associated $\mathcal O_Y$-module for the $S$-module $S\otimes_R M$.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01BJ (lemma-restrict-quasi-coherent), including its proof via the ringed-space pullback construction and the tensor extension of scalars
